title: The D23 replay is rerun with infra failures retried and a monotonic clock
body:
Outcome: D23 arm K is rerun at the adopted model with infra-failed arms (exit!=0 with no commit, timeout) retried once, lead seconds from a monotonic clock, and failures split into code, process and infra. Why: 494.K exit 1 at 3 s and 487.K timeout counted as cost 0; lead_seconds negative (-79746, -91928); K arms were recycled from C3 per tasks/t-g2x9kw7.json:18; P was correct 11/20 vs K 7/20. Proof: a new 20-row table with no negative or zero-cost arms. Scope: .krn/runs/d23-comparison only.
Evidence: .krn/runs/qwen-research/report.md (Qwen 4 audit) verified by krn-reader against HEAD 8152cee.
